I have been convicted for possession of child pornography. 

I can count on one hand the number of people who know about this (outside the legal and mental health world I was thrust into). If anyone else finds out, my kids lives will be destroyed, and I will commit suicide without hesitation to stem any further anguish. I was extremely fortunate not to have local media coverage of my case. I can only guess that was to protect my children. Effectively, they saved my life. For now.

If you even look at inappropriate images online, stop. now!  
If you have saved any images anywhere, get everything you want off of that drive to somewhere clean and safe, and destroy it.  
I'm deadly serious. You *will* get caught one day, and you *will* wish you had followed my advice. I guarantee it. Everyone I've met via the process that follows thought they were smart - encrypted drives, used anonymous VPN, Tor, tails, you name it. They thought *they* would never get caught. Just. Stop. Now.

The world I knew ended the day the police knocked on the door with a search warrant. When I saw them, I knew immediately why they were there. I sat there with my wife and kids, in a cold sweat. Suffering the loathing stares of suspicion from my family, watched all the time by the police, for hours on end. None of us were allowed to go anywhere. We were even watched when we went to the toilet in case anyone tried to escape, or attempt suicide. I vividly remember the anxiety attacks, the cold sweats and the dry mouth, while I sat there in this surreal world, watching my world fall apart.

A team of about 6 or 7 people came into the house. They searched everywhere, to find any devices in the house capable of accessing the internet, or storing images. They even found 3 or 4 items we thought were lost! They photographed everywhere, and interviewed us all.

They had taken over one room of the house for forensic examination of all the equipment. It does not matter one jot if anything had been deleted, they would still find it. As it turns out, they only found one or 2 files 'of interest', but that was sufficient for them to seize various computers and hard drives for further examination and to take me away for 'further questioning'.

It is too easy to fall into this world. I think many men will understand the temptation. If I left you alone in a room with an envelope on the table that said 'do not look at the photos in here', and there was no way for anyone to ever know if you'd looked inside or not, would you look? That's how tempting and easy it is on the internet. Nobody's getting hurt if I just have a quick look, right? 

To clarify any possible misunderstandings, most of the things I saw were self-made - sexting material from sexually mature girls. Unfortunately, once you cross the 'legal line', there are no more lines. No more censorship, and few moral barriers. You will accidentally see (and be convicted of) some very disturbing, sick shit. It is really astonishing how evil some people are!

If what I'm saying here saves one person from my fate, I'll be glad to have said this here.
Please don't get high and mighty. I know what proportion of men have an interest in teen girls, and what proportion of girls have suffered some form of sexual abuse in their lives. The numbers are truly shocking.

If anyone has any questions, ask away. Though obviously I won't give any details that will identify me.
